description: Offline official-source-backed OUTSIDELANE seed questions across World/European/USATF indoor/outdoor championships, World Top Lists, Diamond League, 2025/2026 UK outdoor championships and 2025 World Marathon Majors. Some championship questions are explicitly curated partial indexes. No live scraping or actual player rarity analytics.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete entered for the 2025 World Indoor Championships in Nanjing.
questions.note: Any event or nationality. Official entry list dated 15 March 2025.

questions.prompt: Name a woman entered for the 2025 World Indoor Championships.
questions.note: Sprint, distance, hurdles, jumps, throws and combined events all count.

questions.prompt: Name a man entered for the 2025 World Indoor Championships.
questions.note: Any individual event or relay entry on the official list.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete entered in the men’s 800m, 1500m or 3000m at Nanjing 2025.
questions.note: Any of those three men’s events qualifies.

questions.prompt: Name a woman entered for the 800m, 1500m or 3000m at Nanjing 2025.
questions.note: World Indoors 2025 official entry list.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete entered for the European Indoor Championships in Apeldoorn 2025.
questions.note: Official European Athletics final entries, excluding reserves where indicated.

questions.prompt: Name a woman entered for the 2025 European Indoor Championships.
questions.note: From 60m to pentathlon — every individual event counts.

questions.prompt: Name a field-event athlete entered for Apeldoorn 2025.
questions.note: Jumps, throws or combined-events entrants qualify.

questions.prompt: Name a pole vaulter entered in the 2025 European Indoor Championships.
questions.note: Men’s or women’s pole vault.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete who competed at the 2025 USATF Indoor Championships.
questions.note: Official results from Staten Island, 22–23 February 2025.

questions.prompt: Name a woman who competed at the 2025 USATF Indoor Championships.
questions.note: Any women’s track or field event in the official results.

questions.prompt: Name a runner in the 2025 USATF Indoor men’s 800m or 1500m.
questions.note: Heats and finals both count.

questions.prompt: Name a runner in the women’s 800m, 1500m or 3000m at USATF Indoors 2025.
questions.note: Finishers and preliminary-round competitors qualify.

questions.prompt: Name a men’s field-event athlete who competed at USATF Indoors 2025.
questions.note: Long jump, triple jump, pole vault, throws or combined events.

questions.prompt: Name a woman entered in the 2025 USATF indoor shot put or weight throw.
questions.note: Names appear in the official event results.

questions.prompt: Name a man ranked 50th or better on the 2025 World Athletics 100m season Top List.
questions.note: Wind-legal outdoor performances; athletes tied in 47th place all qualify. World Top Lists, not points-based World Rankings.

questions.prompt: Name a man who ran the 100m first round at the 2025 World Athletics Championships.
questions.note: Any of the seven official first-round heats in Tokyo counts — not just the final.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete listed in the men’s 1500m final at Tokyo 2025 World Outdoors.
questions.note: Official final result includes 13 finishers and one disqualification.

questions.prompt: Name a man who raced in the 100m at the 2026 European Athletics Championships.
questions.note: Birmingham 2026: first round, semifinals or final count (excluding decathlon 100m).

questions.prompt: Name a podium finisher in one of the featured 2025 USATF Outdoor track or field finals.
questions.note: Selected official-result events: 100m, 200m, 800m, 5000m, hurdles, high jump, pole vault, triple jump, shot put and discus.

questions.prompt: Name a podium finisher in shot put, triple jump, high jump, discus or pole vault at USATF Outdoors 2025.
questions.note: Selected men’s and women’s finals reported by USATF; third-place finishers count.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete who won a 2026 Wanda Diamond League season title.
questions.note: All 32 Diamond Trophy winners at the Brussels 2026 Final count, across track and field.

questions.prompt: Name a field-event athlete who became a 2026 Diamond League champion.
questions.note: High jump, long jump, triple jump, throws and pole vault; no sprint or distance answers.

questions.prompt: Name a male winner of a 2025 Diamond League season title in Zurich.
questions.note: All 16 men’s Diamond Trophy winners at the 2025 Zurich Final count.

questions.prompt: Name a city that hosted a 2025 Diamond League meeting or Final.
questions.note: Includes the 14 qualifying meetings and the Final in Zurich. For Silesia, Chorzów is the host city.

questions.prompt: Name a 2026 UK Athletics Outdoor Championships winner featured in the day-one report.
questions.note: Birmingham 20 June 2026. Selected track, field and para finals highlighted by British Athletics.

questions.prompt: Name a 2026 UK Athletics Outdoor Championships winner featured in the day-two report.
questions.note: Birmingham 21 June 2026. Named champions across track and field; this is an indexed subset.

questions.prompt: Name a medallist in the men’s or women’s 100m at the 2025 UK Athletics Outdoor Championships.
questions.note: Alexander Stadium, Birmingham. All six podium places in the two 100m finals count.

questions.prompt: Name a medallist in the men’s 200m at the 2025 UK Athletics Outdoor Championships.
questions.note: Alexander Stadium, Birmingham; all three men’s 200m medallists count.

questions.prompt: Name a city that hosted a World Marathon Major in 2025.
questions.note: Seven host cities; Sydney became a Major in 2025. Cape Town did not host a Major in 2025.

questions.prompt: Name a man who won an elite World Marathon Major race in 2025.
questions.note: Six different men won the seven 2025 Majors: Sabastian Sawe won both London and Berlin.

questions.prompt: Name a woman who won an elite World Marathon Major race in 2025.
questions.note: Seven different women won the seven Majors. Elite open division, not wheelchair or age-group categories.

questions.prompt: Name an elite men’s or women’s World Marathon Major winner from 2025.
questions.note: Any of the 13 distinct elite winners in the seven 2025 Major races counts.
